description: This file defines a utility class PasswordEncode that provides methods for password encoding and verification using BCryptPasswordEncoder from Spring Security.

classes.name: PasswordEncode
classes.description: A utility class for encoding passwords and checking password validity using BCrypt.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new BCryptPasswordEncoder instance for encoding passwords.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Checks whether a raw password matches an encrypted password.
